scope: Separate queue navigation from initiative navigation; queues contain tickets only. Preserve initiative position/state when entering/leaving queues. Keep original Ready/Review/Blocked/All membership predicates unchanged.

Centralize queue selection/update logic rather than duplicate keyboard/mouse/recovery paths. Preserve selected ticket by canonical identity across live changes; explain departure and select a valid nearest row. Keep selection/scroll stable on Return.

Opening a queue ticket resolves its real initiative or Ungrouped canonical context; Esc returns logically to the selected queue. Keep per-project/workspace navigation serializable through existing ExplorerNavigation.

Uppercase R refreshes; lowercase r remains Review. Preserve workspace number shortcuts. No empty action menu without a valid selected target; preserve disabled reasons and safe current canonical targets.

Retain last readable data on refresh failure and continue blocking unsafe transitions. Keep loading distinct from empty. Preserve existing readers, events, Files, copy/actions, Unicode/sanitization and source/evidence authority.
